primaryScope: Fixed-geometry proper on both sides; L=3,k=2 periodic/open; stationary feedback and complete edge-emitting temporal realizations of at most two states.
directionProvenance: Selected before new controller search, using frozen exact Stage IV pools: original density/cost directions plus three nearby open-boundary separating directions for feedback-4-00010. Archive-only mu/nu screen is direction selection, never controller-family exhaustion. Periodic 1,3/25 is a countercheck to the analogous tradeoff.

lowerSearch.role: Exploratory feasible lower candidates only; rational absorption verifies retained winners.

wordUpper.role: Adaptive infinite-word prefix partition with exact integer propagation and certified full-information suffix. Covers all temporal word laws, not merely two-state.

parameterUpper.role: Two product simplexes of four joint emission/update probabilities. Box-simplex LP Bellman relaxation covers every stationary edge-HMM parameter, including proper singular boundaries; initial distribution is reduced by linearity, not by omitting it.

feedbackPool: All 13 frozen structural <=2-state classes are checked for fixed-geometry properness from existing operational automata. Proper nonconstant laws have exact randomized minimum two by deterministic H/V histories. Nonproper classes are not assigned a jam reward.
convexHull: Use exact rational membership weights in archived feasible <=2-state temporal objective points. Hull membership is separate from implementability of a persistent mixture with only two internal states.
stopping: Retain certified unresolved intervals if strict capability separation cannot close within these declared budgets. No Stage VI, no memory/shape/large-L expansion, no new rare-event model.
deliverables: Unified nonchronological English manuscript, Chinese summary, primary literature notes, FINAL_REVIEW, exact certificate verifier, clean-source reconstruction and hashes. PROJECT STATUS: PAUSED AFTER STAGE V. No PDF.
